children: Distracted launches a single-player poker game on Solana on 24 Oct 2026. The game uses Arcium-powered cryptographic randomness for card shuffling, putting Arcium's technology into use in an online gaming product.

Arcium's randomness technology supports fair shuffling of the deck. The launch demonstrates a practical use for cryptographic randomness, with Arcium providing the randomness behind how the game's cards are shuffled.
Distracted is now live on Arcium.
Single-player poker with cryptographic randomness, powered by Arcium.

title: Arcium: Distracted launches single-player poker on Solana - 24 Oct 2026
